newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Denmark sees lower German bond yield gap.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Denmark sees lower German bond yield gap.

text.p: Denmark's Economy Ministry said in its latest economic survey issued on Monday that it expected the 10-year bond yield gap between Denmark and Germany would fall to 50 basis points by the end of 1997.
The present differential is around 80 basis points.
In its survey it also forecast that the 10-year Danish interest rate would be on average 7.30 percent in 1996, rising to 7.50 percent next year.
Today's interest rate on the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 is around 6.80 percent.
